description:
Children of God Foundation (COGF) is a Non-profitable Organization, established in 2006 with a unique vision, to transform the young lives on the streets through Gods love, better security and right education.
COGF reaches out to these children through our outreach program, they then become involved in step-in- center(Kurla/Kalwa/Atgaon) later if the child needs shelter to complete his/her education, then the child is rehabilitated in our step-up residential schooling(Airoli)
COGF also works among the tribals in atgaon in the field of education, health, livelihood and advocacy.

owner_posts.post_text: 💧 In Sakhroli Pada, Atgaon, 1,019 tribal villagers once depended on a risky pond for daily needs. Together, the Children of God Foundation Pragati Team, village leaders, and community members built an RCC well in just one month. ✨ Inaugurated on March 19, 2026, the well now provides safe water, supports livestock, improves health and hygiene, and brings dignity, hope, and a brighter future to the entire village. 🌱

Art, culture, and creativity came alive at the Kala Ghoda Arts Festival! 🎨 COGF Boys and Girls explored Asia’s largest street art celebration in Mumbai’s historic Fort area. ✨ From colorful installations to live performances and workshops, every moment sparked imagination and inspiration. Experiences like these open young minds to creativity, confidence, and new possibilities.

✨ Smiles grew brighter at Savardev Municipal School on 27/11/25 as the newly developed School Play Zone was inaugurated by COGF. 🌟 Created for 28 children, this vibrant and secure space promotes active play, creativity, and holistic well-being. 🛝 By giving children a place to move, imagine, and connect, this initiative supports healthier growth and joyful learning every day.

A day filled with learning, laughter, and adventure at Dirghayu Farm. 🌿 Children explored the mango farm, learned about composting, enjoyed a traditional bullock cart ride, felt the thrill of ziplining, and had endless fun playing in the swimming pool. 🌱 Nature turned into a joyful classroom, creating beautiful memories and meaningful learning experiences for every child.

We extend our heartfelt thanks to CitiusTech for inviting us to their Diwali Sale. ✨ It was a proud and joyful moment to display products lovingly made by our children. 🧵🎁 Their creativity and hard work received wonderful appreciation, boosting their confidence and dreams. Such platforms truly empower young talent and make this initiative even more meaningful. 🪔

featured_reviews.name: Threza Menezes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am glad to make my second innings at the REAP after my retirement, offering voluntary services.
REAP is an NGO working for the growth of the lesser privileged families in the slums of Kalwa and are doing a great job not only in the field of education but also grooming the young generation with some skills to earn their livelihood.
It is truly joyful to see the toddlers step in to their nursery class eagerly to sing the rhymes and learn to count on their gentle fingers.
The classes conducted for the children of higher standards are also taught meticulously.  Besides training them with their academic curriculum, they are also taught etiquettes and kind gestures when exposed to society.
Teachers at REAP are commendable, making great efforts to teach the children and prepare them for their unit test and exams held in schools. Children get involved and are attracted by the pleasing attitude of our teachers. For children who find difficulty in certain subjects, remedial classes are  conducted to cope up with their syllabus. REAP ensures that the children in the remotest area of Kalwa get the right to education and hence has 5 centres situated in close proximity of the homes of the children.
Nevertheless REAP teachers are also given training frequently by resourceful persons and the teachers are motivated as seen by almost 100% attendance at these sessions.
REAP has also explored into STEM education developing technical skills and knowledge for the future career of the children. REAP has also gone a step forward with training in Robotics, an extension of engineering as well as training in computers.  Children are fascinated by these subjects and the joy can be seen on their faces when a model is completed by them.

REAP is coming up with a crash course on hospitality and beautician/parlour for the dropouts which will generate professionals and also self respect and lead a dignified life in society.

It’s a great opportunity and privilege to be associated with REAP and to serve the deprived class of the society which will definitely give the best of results as the proverb says “as you sow so shall you reap.”
